name: How do I choose the right builder for my custom tiny home project?
description: Choose a tiny home builder based on experience, portfolio, customer reviews, local code knowledge, transparent pricing, and licensing.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right builder for my custom tiny home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right builder involves evaluating their experience, portfolio of completed tiny homes, customer testimonials, and understanding of local zoning and building codes. Look for a builder with transparent pricing, clear communication, and a comprehensive design-build process. Ensure they are licensed and insured. Zen Tiny Homes emphasizes its expertise in custom tiny home construction across San Diego County, offering transparent processes and local regulatory knowledge.
